    async def refresh_status_panels(self) -> None:
        channels = self.target_channels()
        if not channels:
            return

        embed = self._build_status_embed()
        for channel in channels:
            key = str(channel.id)
            async with self.state_lock:
                status_messages = self.state.setdefault("status_messages", {})
                raw_message_id = status_messages.get(key)

            message: discord.Message | None = None
            if raw_message_id:
                try:
                    message = await channel.fetch_message(int(raw_message_id))
                except (ValueError, discord.NotFound, discord.Forbidden, discord.HTTPException):
                    message = None

            if message is None:
                try:
                    async for candidate in channel.history(limit=30):
                        if (
                            self.bot.user is not None
                            and candidate.author.id == self.bot.user.id
                            and candidate.embeds
                            and candidate.embeds[0].title == "Arctic Wipe Takibi"
                        ):
                            message = candidate
                            break
                except (discord.Forbidden, discord.HTTPException):
                    pass

            try:
                if message is None:
                    message = await channel.send(
                        embed=embed,
                        allowed_mentions=discord.AllowedMentions.none(),
                    )
                else:
                    await message.edit(embed=embed)
            except (discord.Forbidden, discord.HTTPException) as exc:
                log.warning("Kalıcı wipe paneli güncellenemedi [%s]: %s", channel, exc)
                continue

            async with self.state_lock:
                status_messages = self.state.setdefault("status_messages", {})
                if status_messages.get(key) != message.id:
                    status_messages[key] = message.id
                    _write_state(self.state)
